claims 1-10 are rejected under 35 u.s.c. 112(b) or 35 u.s.c. 112 (pre-aia ), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor (or for applications subject to pre-aia 35 u.s.c. 112, the applicant), regards as the invention.
due to the number of 112(b) rejections presented below, if any clarity regarding said rejections would be helpful to expedite prosecution, applicant is invited to contact examiner michael hotchkiss at the number listed in the conclusion below.
